questions.question:
A box contains 10 screws, 3 of which are defective. Two screws are drawn at
random with replacement. The probability that none of the two screws is defective
will be
questions.explanation:
Total number of screws = 10 Number of defective screws = 3 Number of non-defective screws = [latex]10 - 3 = 7[/latex] Probability of selecting a non-defective screw in one draw: [latex]P(\text{non-defective}) = \frac{7}{10}[/latex] Since the screws are drawn with replacement, the two events are independent. So, the probability that both screws drawn are non-defective is: [latex]
P(\text{both non-defective}) = \left(\frac{7}{10}\right)^2 = \frac{49}{100} = 0.49
[/latex] Hence, the required probability is 49%.

Number of defective screws = 3
Number of non-defective screws = [latex]10 - 3 = 7[/latex]

Probability of selecting a non-defective screw in one draw:
[latex]P(\text{non-defective}) = \frac{7}{10}[/latex]

Since the screws are drawn with replacement, the two events are independent. So, the probability that both screws drawn are non-defective is:
[latex] P(\text{both non-defective}) = \left(\frac{7}{10}\right)^2 = \frac{49}{100} = 0.49 [/latex]

Hence, the required probability is 49%.

questions.question: Muller Breslau's principle in structural analysis is used for

options.A: drawing influence line diagram for any force function

questions.explanation:
Muller Breslau's principle is a principle on the 
basis of which it is possible to draw influence lines 
for various quantities pertaining to a structure. It 
states that: "The ordinates of the influence lines for any stress 
element (such as axial stress, moment or reaction) 
of any structure are proportional to those of deflection 
curve, which is obtained by removing the restraint 
corresponding to that element from the structure and 
introducing in its place a deformation into the primary 
structure which remains."

questions.explanation: Permeability = Hydraulic conductivity [latex]\left ( \frac{\mu }{\rho g} \right )[/latex] A storm of i=0.5 cm/hr occurs over the soil for an indefinite period. What is the meaning of "indefinite period"? In order to achieve steady state condition, continuous application of water is necessary so that the water level is maintained constant. 'Surface drainage adequate' means at steady state condition some water flows as surface runoff. 'Storm has lasted for a very long time' means the hydraulic conductivity approaches saturated hydraulic conductivity (so that Darcy's law can be obeyed) and at steady state condition infiltration rate is also constant. The constant infiltration rate which is achieved after very long time, shall be more than 0.2 cm/hr (as hydraulic conductivity has increased) but should be less than storm intensity 0.5 cm/hr due to adequate drainage.
